_comment: Allowlist anti-slopsquatting (check-deps.mjs). Toda dep nova exige adicao EXPLICITA aqui apos verificar que e legitima.

_justifications.@testing-library/dom: Peer dep obrigatoria de @testing-library/react v16 (adicionada no PR #11224); Refs #9985.
_justifications.@testing-library/user-event: Utilitario oficial do ecossistema testing-library para testes de UI (adicionada no PR #11224); Refs #9985.
_justifications.@opencode/plugin: Official OpenCode plugin SDK consumed by the bundled opencode-plugin-v2 package; required by its package-local runtime/types contract.
_justifications.babel-plugin-react-compiler: Official React Compiler Babel plugin (facebook/react, MIT). Required peer of Next.js 16 `reactCompiler: true`; Next declares it optional (`*`) and does not auto-install. Added by PR #11783 / issue #67.
_justifications.eslint-plugin-react-hooks: React Hooks lint rules (set-state-in-effect, immutability, refs, purity) pinned at 7.0.1 by the release/v3.8.51 cycle; the 224 findings it raised are tracked in #11924. Refs #11924.
_justifications.remark-gfm: Official unified/remark plugin adding GitHub Flavored Markdown support; direct dependency ported with the docs/toolchain sync.
_justifications.markdownlint-cli2: Pinned project-local Markdown lint CLI (markdownlint-cli2@0.23.2, MIT) restored from the pre-merge AgentProxy toolchain contract to replace mutable registry-current npx execution.
_justifications.node-gyp: Pinned project-local native addon build tool (node-gyp@13.0.2, MIT) restored from the pre-merge AgentProxy toolchain contract for deterministic tproxy builds instead of mutable npx execution.
_justifications.@anthropic-ai/claude-code: Official Anthropic Claude Code CLI; reviewed exact runtime-tool versions 2.1.258/2.1.260 from registry.npmjs.org with Anthropic maintainers and SHA-512 lock integrity.
_justifications.@openai/codex: Official OpenAI Codex CLI; reviewed exact runtime-tool version 0.155.0, repository openai/codex, OpenAI publisher/maintainers, and SHA-512 lock integrity.
_justifications.brace-expansion: Security overlay dependency pinned to 5.0.12 to remediate vulnerable transitive versions; upstream juliangruber/brace-expansion, npm integrity lock enforced.
_justifications.droid: Factory AI Droid CLI; reviewed exact runtime-tool version 0.212.0, repository Factory-AI/factory, factory.ai maintainers, and SHA-512 lock integrity.
_justifications.http-cache-semantics: Security overlay dependency pinned to 4.3.0 to remediate vulnerable transitive versions; upstream kornelski/http-cache-semantics, npm integrity lock enforced.
_justifications.ip-address: Security overlay dependency pinned to 10.7.3; upstream beaugunderson/ip-address, npm integrity lock enforced.
_justifications.openclaw: OpenClaw CLI; reviewed exact runtime-tool version 2026.9.1, repository openclaw/openclaw, and SHA-512 lock integrity.
_justifications.postcss-selector-parser: Security overlay dependency pinned to 7.1.6; upstream postcss/postcss-selector-parser, npm integrity lock enforced.
_justifications.tar: Security overlay dependency pinned to 7.5.22; upstream isaacs/node-tar, npm integrity lock enforced.
